name: Paneer butter masala
steps: Blend the tinned tomatoes into a smooth sauce.
Melt butter and fry garam masala, chilli powder and ginger for a minute.
Pour in the tomato and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, then add the cubed paneer and warm through.
Serve with warm naan and a pinch of dried fenugreek.
